// diagnostic E1222

Jet.InvalidProgramAllocator

Invalid hosted program allocator

What

Invalid hosted program allocator

Why

`allocator:` must be `mem.Heap` or `mem.Counting.over(mem.Heap, cap: <bytes>)`, with `cap:` a positive whole-byte quantity that fits in 64 bits.

Fix

Use `allocator: mem.Heap` or `mem.Counting.over(mem.Heap, cap: 2.gb)`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.InvalidProgramAllocator: Tests/UI/ManifestBadAllocator/stderr.

Error: Jet.InvalidProgramAllocator: Invalid hosted program allocator
  --> package.jet:3:1
    |
  3 | allocator: mem.Mystery
    | ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `allocator:` must be `mem.Heap` or `mem.Counting.over(mem.Heap, cap: <bytes>)`
 Fix: Use `allocator: mem.Heap` or wrap it with `allocator: mem.Counting.over(mem.Heap, cap: 2.gb)`
